verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a built-in chat assistant that builds agents or automations from a plain-language description, and can rewrite an existing agent's instructions and tools on request. It also ships native AI agents that you brief in plain language: they decide the steps and carry out the work using the app actions you attach, and anything you want to check first waits for your approval. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-product assistant, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
